scope: added startup validation so bad parameters fail loudly instead of silently
problem: round 112: --gamestate-map mp_afghan changed the gamestate payload but configstring 0 / connectResponse still used the default - a parameter that looked applied but was not
round 113: the map had no fastfile, so the client disconnected, which was only understood after a full session
a mistyped --snapshot-file only failed later, when the client was already running
validation_added: --gamestate-map: each comma-separated name must be non-empty, <= 32 chars, and a plain map name (no path separators, spaces or wildcards)
--snapshot-file: every listed path must exist at startup

verified.bad_map: --gamestate-map 'mp_cross/fire' -> exit 2, 'is not a plain map name'

why_it_matters: both categories cost a full client session to diagnose in the past
failing at startup in milliseconds removes that entire class of wasted experiments
